title: The optimal road trip across the U.S. stopping at the U.S. National Parks

quoted_total.source: post text: 'this road trip spans 14,498 miles (23,333 km) of road...roughly 2 months' (vague, not converted)

stops.name: Mather Point
stops.query: Mather Point, Rim Trail, Grand Canyon Village, Arizona
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Mather Point overlook on the South Rim Rim Trail (Wikidata P625). Drive = Grand Canyon Visitor Center parking (NPS API coordinates), a 300 m walk from the overlook.

stops.name: Petrified Forest National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Painted Desert Visitor Center at the I-40 north entrance, which the route from Grand Canyon reaches first. Old Nominatim point (34.974,-109.708) was 12 km SE in the park interior, off the road network.

stops.name: Saguaro National Park Visitor Center
stops.query: Saguaro National Park Visitor Center, North Kinney Road, Tucson, Arizona
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Red Hills Visitor Center, 2700 N Kinney Rd, Saguaro West (NPS API; the Census match for the address is 200 m away). Old Nominatim point was Saguaro East (Rincon Mountain district), 55 km away.

stops.name: Guadalupe Mountains National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Pine Springs Visitor Center on US 62/180. Old Nominatim point was 7.8 km WNW in the backcountry.

stops.name: Carlsbad Caverns National Park
stops.query: Carlsbad Caverns National Park, New Mexico
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: the visitor center at the end of the entrance road. Old Nominatim point was 16 km SW, off the road network.

stops.name: Big Bend National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Panther Junction Visitor Center (park headquarters). Old Nominatim point was 1.3 km ENE of it.

stops.name: Hot Springs National Park
stops.query: Hot Springs National Park, Hot Springs, Arizona 71901
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. The query says 'Arizona 71901', but ZIP 71901 and the park are in Hot Springs, Arkansas, so it is kept as Hot Springs National Park, AR. Point = Fordyce Bathhouse Visitor Center on Bathhouse Row, Central Ave (NPS API). Old point was 2.7 km NE, on Hot Springs Mountain.

stops.name: Mammoth Cave National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: visitor center on Mammoth Cave Pkwy. Old point was 2 km W.

stops.name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
stops.query: Great Smoky Mountains National Park, Tennessee
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names the park and Tennessee; point = Sugarlands Visitor Center, the main Tennessee-side visitor center near Gatlinburg (NPS API). Old Nominatim point was a backcountry centroid 13 km SE.

stops.name: Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center
stops.query: Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center, 40001 State Hwy 9336, Homestead, FL 33034
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center, 40001 SR 9336 (NPS API; Wikidata Q36036101 agrees within 5 m).

stops.name: Dry Tortugas National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Boat or seaplane only. Display = Garden Key Visitor Center at Fort Jefferson (NPS API). Drive = Key West ferry terminal, Grinnell St, where the Yankee Freedom departs (Wikidata Q5309561 'Dry Tortugas Ferry'), about 109 km east. Old point was 1.2 km N of the fort, in open water.

stops.name: Biscayne National Park - Dante Fascell Visitor Center
stops.query: Biscayne National Park - Dante Fascell Visitor Center, 9700 SW 328th St, Homestead, FL 33033
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Dante Fascell Visitor Center, 9700 SW 328th St, Convoy Point (NPS API; the Census address match is 280 m W on 328th St).

stops.name: Congaree National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Harry Hampton Visitor Center, 100 National Park Rd, Hopkins. Old Nominatim point was a floodplain centroid 7 km SE.

stops.name: Shenandoah National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Harry F. Byrd Sr. Visitor Center, Big Meadows, Skyline Drive MP 51. Old point (38.472,-78.464) was on the park boundary, off the road network.

stops.name: Acadia National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Same string as major-landmarks row 28. Display = the park's Wikidata P625. Drive = Sand Beach on the Park Loop Road, following that page's 2015 Google distance-matrix evidence that the Acadia endpoint was deep in the park, well past Hulls Cove Visitor Center. There is no matrix for this 2016 page; alternative: Hulls Cove VC 44.408542,-68.246137.

stops.name: Cuyahoga Valley National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Boston Mill Visitor Center, Boston Mills Rd (opened 2019; the 2016-era Boston Store Visitor Center was about 200 m E on the same road). Old point was 2.1 km ESE.

stops.name: Isle Royale National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Island park, reachable only by boat or seaplane. Display = the park (Wikidata Q163515 P625). Drive = Houghton Visitor Center and Ranger III ferry dock, 800 E Lakeshore Dr, Houghton, MI, the park's mainland headquarters (NPS API; NPS Houghton page GPS 47.1229074,-88.5636891). Old point was on the island.

stops.name: Voyageurs National Park
stops.query: Voyageurs National Park, International Falls, Minnesota 56649
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names the park and International Falls; point = Rainy Lake Visitor Center, the park's main year-round visitor center with an International Falls address (NPS API). Old Nominatim point was a spot in town 16 km W.

stops.name: South Unit Visitor Center
stops.query: South Unit Visitor Center, Medora, ND 58645
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Theodore Roosevelt NP South Unit Visitor Center in Medora, ND (NPS API; the Maltese Cross Cabin is behind it). Old Nominatim point was a 'South Unit' place in Kittson County, Minnesota, 567 km away.

stops.name: White River Visitor Center
stops.query: White River Visitor Center, Porcupine, SD 57772
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Badlands NP White River Visitor Center on BIA 27 (NPS API; matches Wikidata Q36483767).

stops.name: Wind Cave National Park Visitor Center
stops.query: Wind Cave National Park Visitor Center, Hot Springs, South Dakota
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Wind Cave Visitor Center (NPS API; matches Wikidata Q71742084).

stops.name: Rocky Mountain National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Beaver Meadows Visitor Center (park headquarters) on US 36 W of Estes Park. Old Nominatim point was a mountain centroid 13 km W.

stops.name: Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve
stops.query: Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve, Colorado
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Previously ungeocoded. Great Sand Dunes Visitor Center (NPS API), the park's main visitor center; the park's Wikidata P625 sits on it.

stops.name: 9800 CO-347
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. 9800 CO-347 is the address of the Black Canyon of the Gunnison South Rim Visitor Center (NPS API; Wikidata Q63437783 within 30 m). Old Nominatim address interpolation was 4.9 km SW on CO 347.

stops.name: Mesa Verde Visitor and Research Center
stops.query: Mesa Verde Visitor and Research Center, Mancos, CO 81328
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Previously ungeocoded. Mesa Verde Visitor and Research Center at the park entrance off US 160 (NPS API; Wikidata Q64007148 within 30 m).

stops.name: Canyonlands National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Island in the Sky Visitor Center, the main district nearest Moab (NPS API). Old Nominatim point was deep in the Maze and Needles backcountry, 26 km SW. The Needles Visitor Center (38.168096,-109.759410) is the other candidate.

stops.name: Arches National Park Visitor Center
stops.query: Arches National Park Visitor Center, Moab, UT 84532
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Arches Visitor Center on US 191 (NPS API; matches Wikidata Q63989677).

stops.name: Capitol Reef National Park Visitor Center
stops.query: Capitol Reef National Park Visitor Center, UT-24, Torrey, UT 84775
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Capitol Reef Visitor Center on UT 24 in Fruita (NPS API; matches Wikidata Q63993567).

stops.name: Bryce Canyon National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Bryce Canyon Visitor Center on UT 63. Old point was 8 km SSW, off the road network.

stops.name: Zion National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Zion Canyon Visitor Center by the south entrance, Springdale. Old point was 13.7 km N in the backcountry.

stops.name: Great Basin National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Lehman Caves Visitor Center (in the park, on Lehman Caves Rd). Old point was 7 km SE.

stops.name: Grand Teton National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Craig Thomas Discovery and Visitor Center at Moose (park headquarters). Old point was 18 km N, in the interior.

stops.name: West Yellowstone Visitor Information Center
stops.query: West Yellowstone Visitor Information Center, 30 Yellowstone Ave, West Yellowstone, MT 59758
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. West Yellowstone Visitor Information Center, 30 Yellowstone Ave (NPS API, NPS desk). Old point was a town centroid 560 m N.

stops.name: Glacier National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Apgar Visitor Center at the west entrance, on the route from West Yellowstone toward North Cascades. Old point was 20 km NE, in the interior.

stops.name: North Cascades National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: North Cascades Visitor Center, Newhalem, on WA 20. Old point was 19 km N, in the backcountry.

stops.name: Mount Rainier National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Henry M. Jackson Memorial Visitor Center at Paradise. Old point was 8 km NNE, on the mountain's upper slopes.

stops.name: Olympic National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Olympic National Park Visitor Center, Port Angeles. Old point was a mountain centroid 36 km S.

stops.name: Crater Lake National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Steel Visitor Center at park headquarters, Munson Valley (open year-round). Old point was 3.9 km N, in the lake.

stops.name: Redwood National and State Parks
stops.query: Redwood National and State Parks, California
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Thomas H. Kuchel Visitor Center on US 101 at Orick. Old point was 20 km N, in the interior.

stops.name: Lassen Volcanic National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Kohm Yah-mah-nee Visitor Center at the SW entrance on CA 89. Old point was 12 km NE, off the road network.

stops.name: Yosemite National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Yosemite Valley Visitor Center, Yosemite Village (Wikidata P625). Old point was 12 km N in the high country.

stops.name: Kings Canyon National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Kings Canyon Visitor Center, Grant Grove on CA 180. Old point was 37 km E in the backcountry.

stops.name: Sequoia National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Foothills Visitor Center at the Ash Mountain entrance and park headquarters on CA 198. Old point was 24 km E, deep in the backcountry.

stops.name: Pinnacles National Park
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Query names only the park; point = the park's main visitor center per NPS: Pinnacles Visitor Center on the east side off CA 146/25, the main entrance (Wikidata P625; NPS lists it as the Pinnacles Park Store at the same spot). Old point was an interior centroid 2.3 km W.

stops.name: The Robert J. Lagomarsino Visitor Center at Channel Islands National Park
stops.query: The Robert J. Lagomarsino Visitor Center at Channel Islands National Park, 1901 Spinnaker Drive, Ventura, California 93001
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Robert J. Lagomarsino Visitor Center, 1901 Spinnaker Dr, Ventura Harbor (NPS API; Wikidata Q64030993 within 5 m).

stops.name: Joshua Tree National Park
stops.query: Joshua Tree National Park, Twentynine Palms Highway, Twentynine Palms, California
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. The query gives Twentynine Palms Highway, Twentynine Palms, so the point is the Oasis Visitor Center at 74485 National Park Dr, just off the highway (Wikidata P625; Census address match 110 m away). Old point was an interior centroid 27 km S.

stops.name: Furnace Creek Visitor Center
stops.query: Furnace Creek Visitor Center, Furnace Creek, CA 92328
stops.note: verified 2026-09-26. Furnace Creek Visitor Center, Death Valley (NPS API; Wikidata Q36022301 within 30 m).
